playbook: Service levels: service credits: Service credits are capped at 10% of the monthly fee and are the sole remedy. The deal desk may raise the cap to 15%. Credits must always have a maximum: a minimum credit, or no cap, is refused.

request.instructions: You support the deal desk of the Provider, the party that sent the original agreement. The state describes one change the Customer made in the copy it returned, and the playbook passages that apply to it, if any. Judge only this change. The deal desk may accept or counter only what the playbook says it may; anything the playbook reserves for Legal, Finance or another approver, or does not cover, is escalated.

criteria.accept: The playbook lets the deal desk accept this change as written, or the change is purely administrative.
criteria.counter: The playbook gives the deal desk a position or fallback to send back instead of this change.
criteria.escalate: The change needs an approver outside the deal desk, is refused by the playbook, or is not covered by it.

criteria.customer: The change shifts money, risk or flexibility toward the Customer.
criteria.provider: The change shifts money, risk or flexibility toward the Provider.
criteria.neutral: The change does not clearly favour either party.

criteria: Trivial: no commercial or legal effect
Minor: small effect, routine to accept
Moderate: a real concession worth negotiating
Major: changes the economics or the risk of the deal
Critical: should not be signed without senior approval
